title: A Bicycle and a Kitchen Table
subtitle: 友谊关系 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 友谊关系（社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）
meta: 主题语境：友谊关系（社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）　|　核心词汇：skill　|　正文 312 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 skill 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: Daniel and I were friends for eleven years before either of us could have said why. The reason, when I finally saw it, was a ① skill: he could take a bicycle apart and put it back, and I could not, and for eleven years I never once learned, which he never once minded. A skill, as he used to say, is the only thing you can give away and still have.

What he had was not a knack but a ② skill practised since he was eleven, in his father's shed, on bicycles that were not his. He said the ③ skill in it is not knowing what to do but knowing what to do next, and that this is the ④ hardest skill of any to teach, and the one nobody asks to be taught.

He taught me three things in eleven years and I learned one of them. The rest I watched him do ⑤ with skill, which is a different thing from being taught and which, I now think, is the only way anybody has ever learned a skill worth having. What I had, and he did not, were the ⑥ skills that matter at a kitchen table: asking a question and then waiting, which he said looked like nothing and was the ⑦ hardest skill in the house.

When we fell out, in 1998, it was not over anything either of us could name afterwards. He said I had ⑧ no skill at saying what I meant, and he was right. I said he had none at hearing it, and I was right, and neither of us has spoken since.

I have his toolbox, which my mother gave me in 2011 and which I cannot use. It ⑨ requires skill I do not have, and a ⑩ skill he never once showed off, which is the reason it took me eleven years to notice he had any.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 技能；技巧；技艺
B. n. 手艺；专门技术（练出来的本领）
C. n. （社交、沟通的）本事；能力
D. 固定搭配：skill in / at (doing) sth. ……方面的技巧
E. 固定搭配：with skill 熟练地；灵巧地
F. n.[pl.] 各项技能；本领（总称）
G. n. 熟巧；需要技巧（require skill）
H. n. 诀窍；窍门（the skill of ...）

items.q: not a knack but a skill
the skill in it is not knowing what to do
the hardest skill of any to teach
the skills that matter at a kitchen table
the hardest skill in the house
I had no skill at saying what I meant
It requires skill I do not have
a skill he never once showed off

answers.why: a skill 意为“一项技能”，他会拆装自行车，而我不会，这就是我们友谊的原因。
a skill 意为“手艺、练出来的专门技术”，不是天生的窍门，而是从十一岁练出来的。
the skill in doing 意为“做某事的诀窍／技巧所在”，不在于知道该做什么，而在于知道接着做什么。
skill 意为“技能”，这是所有技能里最难教的一项。
with skill 意为“熟练地、灵巧地”，其余的都是我看他熟练地做出来的。
skills 复数意为“各项技能、本领”，指饭桌上那些要紧的本事：会提问，然后会等。
skill 意为“（社交的）本事”，问一句话然后等着的本事，是这家屋子里最难的本事。
skill at doing 意为“做某事的本事／技巧”，他说我毫无说出心里话的本事，他说得对。
require skill 意为“需要技巧、需要熟巧”，那个工具箱需要我没有的技巧。
a skill 意为“一项窍门／本事”，指他从不炫耀、我却花了十一年才发现的那种本事。
